items.t: Nvidia opens investigation after reports CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by Chinese intelligence
items.d: The board of Nvidia on Sunday said that it was opening an independent investigation following reports that CEO Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort.
items.fullText: BREAKING NEWS Nov. 8, 2026, 8:33 PM UTC Artificial intelligence Artificial intelligence Nvidia opens investigation after reports CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by Chinese intelligence Huang acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife in an employee memo. The board said it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 The company added that it “has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised". Anthony Wallace / AFP via Getty Images Share Add NBC News to Google By Steve Kopack The board of Nvidia on Sunday said that it was opening an independent investigation following reports that CEO Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. The announcement followed reporting by The New York Times and the Financial Times about Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese business woman whom the outlets reported had been recruited to spy for China. The two are not related. NBC News has not confirmed either report and has reached out to the Trump administration for comment. “The NVIDIA Board is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort,” the company said in a statement . “A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation. The Board prioritizes U.S. national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of NVIDIA and its shareholders.” The company added that it “has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, the Board’s inquiry will examine all available information.” In memo to Nvidia employees shared by the company with NBC News, Huang said: “I was unfaithful to my wife. items.t: Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo
items.d: A memo circulated earlier this year reportedly claimed that China’s Ministry of State Security recruited a female technology executive to spy on Nvidia's CEO.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 1:17 PM PST · November 7, 2026 Image Credits: Benjamin Fanjoy / Getty Images Anthony Ha Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo A memo circulated earlier this year claimed that technology executive Alice Huang was recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to multiple media reports. The New York Times, which had previously said Nvidia’s chief executive had been the target of Chinese intelligence, was the first to report on the memo . The Financial Times subsequently reported that the memo — supposedly based on U.S. intelligence — also claimed Jensen Huang had a romantic relationship with Alice Huang, an executive at a Singapore-based company called Megaspeed. An Nvidia spokesperson told the NYT that Jensen Huang’s interactions with Alice Huang were “not unusual,” and that the company does not share classified information with its customers. A separate NYT report examined New Matrix, a Chinese company authorized by the U.S. Commerce Department to buy advanced Nvidia chips. But at the office address listed by New Matrix, reporters only found “a hollow gray shell,” raising concerns that it could be a front for a blacklisted private equity firm. items.fullText: Kazakhstan Expands Compute for Its AI Future Jensen Huang’s visit to the nation’s capital, Astana — including a presidential meeting and public fireside chat — coincided with new AI infrastructure commitments anchored by NVIDIA compute. October 22, 2026 by Rev Lebaredian 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Kazakhstan’s AI ecosystem is moving from infrastructure plans to deployment. The shift is visible across the full AI stack — from infrastructure to models to applications. The announcements below — coinciding with a visit to Astana by NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang — point to the nation’s increasing supply of accelerated computing, along with its growing demand for what comes next. On Friday, Oct. 23, NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang visited Astana, meeting with President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev at the Akorda Presidential Palace and joining Deputy Prime Minister Zhaslan Madiyev — Kazakhstan’s minister of AI and digital development — for a public fireside chat at the Alem.AI program. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Jensen Huang and Kazakhstan’s AI Minister Speak at Alem.AI In their fireside chat at Alem.AI, Kazakhstan’s international center for artificial intelligence, Madiyev and Huang discussed the country’s push to become an AI nation — building the energy and computing infrastructure to support homegrown AI and applying it across the economy. Madiyev said Kazakhstan wants AI that reflects its language and culture. “We want AI that understands and speaks Kazakh and captures cultural contexts and cultural specifics,” he said, describing the country’s work on Kazakh-language models. Huang said Kazakhstan could turn its energy resources into a foundation for AI production — and a new kind of export. “Instead of just exporting energy, in the future, you could transform energy into intelligence and export intelligence,” he said. items.fullText: Leading European Financial Services Organizations Embrace Open Models to Build Proprietary Intelligence From transaction foundation models to sovereign cloud deployments, leading financial institutions across Europe are scaling intelligent technologies with advanced computing. October 21, 2026 by Jason Renders 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! At GTC Berlin, banks, payment companies and financial data providers are showing what production-scale intelligence looks like — built on NVIDIA accelerated computing, powered by open weight models and running on their own infrastructure. Revolut is rebuilding its technology stack on a single foundation model PRAGMA , powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing. Using the NVIDIA cuDF toolkit and Dynamo-Triton software on NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs , Revolut is scaling PRAGMA in production, servicing an initial 80 million customers and engineered to scale 3x. “Revolut processes billions of transactions — the opportunity was always there, but the question was whether foundation models could operate at that scale and across domains. PRAGMA answers that,” said Pavel Nesterov, head of AI at Revolut. “Built in collaboration with NVIDIA, it’s the clearest proof yet that the gap between a research breakthrough and a production banking system can be closed.” Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Training on Accelerated Infrastructure Starling Bank , the first bank to train an agentic model on U.K. sovereign cloud infrastructure, has developed “Starling Intelligence” — the intelligence layer that underpins its AI capability — on Civo’s U.K. cloud using the bank’s own transaction data. Lloyds Banking Group built ATUM , a transaction foundation model that converts billions of banking transactions into reusable intelligence — accelerated with NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs and improving efficiency across bank-wide use cases. items.t: AI 속도조절론은 중국의 계략?…젠슨 황과 트럼프의 ‘동상이몽’
items.fullText: 본문 경제 경제일반 AI 속도조절론은 중국의 계략?…젠슨 황과 트럼프의 ‘동상이몽’ 수정 2026-11-07 09:22 펼침 0:00 Your browser does not support the audio element. 따뜻한 AI 따스한 테크 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령(오른쪽)은 2026년 10월8일 백악관에서 ‘과학: 새로운 황금시대 정상회의’라는 이름의 행사를 열어, 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자에게 국가과학훈장을 수여했다. 이 훈장은 미 과학·기술 분야 최고 권위의 상이다. REUTERS 광고 인공지능(AI) 속도조절론이 급부상하던 시점인 2026년 9월14일(이하 현지시각), 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 갑자기 엔비디아의 젠슨 황 최고경영자(CEO)와 공개 통화를 한다. AI의 위험성에 대해 ‘사기’라고 일축하며 AI 개발 속도를 조절해야 한다는 일각의 주장에 공개적으로 반론을 펼친 것이다. 두 사람은 나란히 미국 중심의 AI 발전을 대표하는 인물이다. 한 명은 산업계에서, 다른 한 명은 국가수반이자 정치인으로서 접근한다는 점에서 차이는 있지만, 중국의 AI 속도전 속에서 미국 역시 빠른 AI 개발 속도를 늦출 필요는 전혀 없다는 점을 강조한다. 하지만 당연하게도 직접 만남이 아닌 굳이 전화 통화로서 이런 보여주기식 행동을 펼친 둘의 입장은 분명 차이가 있다. 다시 두 사람의 통화 장면으로 돌아가보자. 통화가 이뤄진 곳은 미국 서부, 캘리포니아주 로스앤젤레스에서 열린 행사장이다. 전통적으로 캘리포니아주는 미국의 전자와 정보기술(IT) 산업의 중심인 실리콘밸리가 있는 곳으로 이들의 목소리를 대변하는 각종 콘퍼런스가 활발히 열린다. 이날 열린 행사 역시 실리콘밸리 산업계가 자신들의 목소리를 내는 자리다. 미국이 아무리 자본주의의 나라라고는 하지만, 미국 대통령이 이런 행사장에 전화 통화로 등장한 것은 갑작스러운 결정에 따른 것이라고 이해할 수밖에 없다. 젠슨 황의 계산과 구상에 트럼프가 발을 맞췄다는 해석이 나오는 대목이다. 광고 AI 속도조절은 중국의 계략일까 대통령의 말은 결국 ‘패권 경쟁 국가’인 중국을 향한다. “AI 개발 속도를 늦추려는 움직임은 정치적 의도나 중국의 계략에 따른 것”이라는 공개적 비판은 음모론을 넘어 실제 현재 미국 행정부가 그런 논리를 강하게 믿고 그에 기반한 판단과 움직임을 보이고 있다는 증거가 된다. 트럼프의 정치적 승부수이고, 이것이 실리콘밸리의 목소리와 부합한다는 의미이기도 하다. 다시 시점을 AI 속도조절론이 (실리콘밸리에서) 처음 나온 때로 돌려보자. ‘클로드’라는 생성형AI를 앞세워 시장에서 가장 뜨거운 기업인 앤트로픽을 이끄는 다리오 아모데이 CEO가 AI 속도조절론을 최근 업계에서 가장 먼저 꺼낸 인물이다. 그것도 트럼프가 중국의 계략을 운운하며 공개적으로 비판한 자리의 바로 전날인 9월13일에 내놓은 내용이다. 단 하루 사이에 갑작스러운 화두 제기와 이에 대한 대통령의 거부 의사가 나타났다. 여기에 깔린 저의는 대체 무엇일까? 광고 광고 아모데이가 AI 속도조절론을 이야기하며 꺼낸 가장 중요한 근거는 ‘안전 조치’다. AI의 발전 속도가 너무 빨라 인류가 이에 대한 안전 조치를 마련할 시간이 부족하다는 설명이다. 이에 대해 챗지피티(ChatGPT) 개발사인 오픈에이아이의 샘 올트먼 CEO나 그록을 개발한 일론 머스크 스페이스엑스 CEO 역시 동조하는 모습을 보였다. AI의 빠른 발전으로 가장 큰 수혜를 입는 집단이 스스로 속도조절을 이야기한 셈인데, 이런 발언을 있는 그대로 순수하게 받아들여서는 현상을 제대로 이해할 수 없다. AI 개발 업체 대표자들은 AI에 대해 ‘그만큼 우리가 안전하게 잘 관리하려는 인식을 갖고 있다’는 것을 사회에 알리겠다는 의도가 큰 행위였다고 하면 과도한 해석일까? 혹은 AI 속도조절 따위는 전혀 신경 쓰지 않는 중국 정부와 기업의 개발 행위에 대해 국제사회의 압박을 가하려는 견제 의도가 있었던 것은 아닐까? 이런저런 해석이 난무하는 가운데 AI 시대의 총아인 엔비디아 대표와 미국 대통령이 입을 모아 반박해버렸다는 점은 우리에게 여러모로
